function rollDice(sides) {
  if (window.crypto && window.crypto.getRandomValues) {
    var b = new Uint32Array(1);
    window.crypto.getRandomValues(b);
    return (b[0] % sides) + 1;
  }
  return Math.floor(Math.random() * sides) + 1;
}

function ensureCharFields(char) {
  var defaults = getDefaultChar();
  ['hp','hpStatus','san','sanStatus','mp','occupation','occupationId','skills','background','weapons','skillReplacements',
   'bgStory','bgAppearance','bgBeliefs','bgImportant','bgPlace','bgTreasure','bgTraits','bgScars','bgPhobias','bgItems','bgExtra','madness'
  ].forEach(function(f) {
    if (char[f] === undefined || char[f] === null) char[f] = defaults[f];
  });
  ['str','con','siz','dex','app','int','pow','edu','luk'].forEach(function(a) {
    if (char[a] === undefined || char[a] === null) char[a] = 10;
  });
  if (!char.skills || typeof char.skills !== 'object') char.skills = {};
  if (!char.weapons || !Array.isArray(char.weapons)) char.weapons = [];
  if (!char.skillReplacements || typeof char.skillReplacements !== 'object') char.skillReplacements = {};
  if (!char.madness || !Array.isArray(char.madness)) char.madness = [];
  return char;
}

function getSkillBase(skillId, char) {
  var sk = SKILL_DATA.find(function(s) { return s.id === skillId; });
  if (!sk) return 0;
  if (sk.autoCalc && sk.calcAttr) {
    var val = parseInt(char[sk.calcAttr], 10) || 10;
    if (sk.id === 'dodge') return Math.floor(val / 2);
    if (sk.id === 'native_lang') return val;
    return val;
  }
  return sk.base || 0;
}

function getSkillTotal(skillId, char) {
  var sk = char.skills[skillId] || {};
  var base = getSkillBase(skillId, char);
  var growth = parseInt(sk.growth, 10) || 0;
  var occ = parseInt(sk.occ, 10) || 0;
  var interest = parseInt(sk.interest, 10) || 0;
  var total = base + growth + occ + interest;
  return Math.min(total, 99);
}

function getSkillName(skillId) {
  var sk = SKILL_DATA.find(function(s) { return s.id === skillId; });
  return sk ? sk.name : skillId;
}

function getSkillCategory(skillId) {
  var sk = SKILL_DATA.find(function(s) { return s.id === skillId; });

}

function isSpecialSkill(skillId) {
  var sk = SKILL_DATA.find(function(s) { return s.id === skillId; });

}

function getSkillDisplayName(skillId, charData) {
  var sk = SKILL_DATA.find(function(s) { return s.id === skillId; });
  if (!sk) return skillId;
  var replacements = charData ? charData.skillReplacements : STATE.skillReplacements;
  if (replacements && replacements[skillId]) {
    return replacements[skillId];
  }
  return sk.name;
}

function getAllSkillsWithData(char) {
  var result = [];
  SKILL_DATA.forEach(function(sk) {
    var base = getSkillBase(sk.id, char);
    var skData = char.skills[sk.id] || {};
    var growth = parseInt(skData.growth, 10) || 0;
    var occ = parseInt(skData.occ, 10) || 0;
    var interest = parseInt(skData.interest, 10) || 0;
    var total = base + growth + occ + interest;
    if (total > 99) total = 99;
    if (base > 0 || growth > 0 || occ > 0 || interest > 0) {
      result.push({
        id: sk.id,
        displayName: getSkillDisplayName(sk.id, char),
        base: base,
        total: total,
        growth: growth,
        occ: occ,
        interest: interest
      });
    }
  });
  return result;
}

    getCharById(charId).then(function(char) {
      if (char) {
        STATE.tempChar = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(char));

        fillBgData(char);
        showFormStep(1);
        showPage('form');

          if (STATE.selectedOccId) {
            renderOccupationList(STATE.selectedOccId);
            renderOptionalSkills();
            renderWeapons();

          }
          renderWeapons();
          renderSkillReplacements();
        }, 100);
      } else { el.errMsg.textContent = '角色不存在'; showPage('list'); }

  } else {

    STATE.tempChar = getDefaultChar();
    clearFormData();
    clearBgData();
    initSkillData();
    STATE.selectedWeapons = [];

}

// ---- 衍生属性 ----
function calcDerived(str, con, siz, pow) {
  var hp = Math.floor((con + siz) / 10);
  var san = pow;
  var mp = Math.floor(pow / 5);
  var total = str + siz;
  var db, build;
  if (total < 2) { db = '-2'; build = '-2'; }
  else if (total >= 2 && total <= 64) { db = '-2'; build = '-2'; }
  else if (total >= 65 && total <= 84) { db = '-1'; build = '-1'; }
  else if (total >= 85 && total <= 124) { db = '0'; build = '0'; }
  else if (total >= 125 && total <= 164) { db = '+1D4'; build = '1'; }
  else if (total >= 165 && total <= 204) { db = '+1D6'; build = '2'; }
  else if (total >= 205 && total <= 284) { db = '+2D6'; build = '3'; }
  else if (total >= 285 && total <= 364) { db = '+3D6'; build = '4'; }
  else if (total >= 365 && total <= 444) { db = '+4D6'; build = '5'; }
  else if (total >= 445 && total <= 524) { db = '+5D6'; build = '6'; }
  else if (total >= 525 && total <= 604) { db = '+6D6'; build = '7'; }
  else if (total >= 605 && total <= 684) { db = '+7D6'; build = '8'; }
  else if (total >= 685 && total <= 764) { db = '+8D6'; build = '9'; }
  else if (total >= 765 && total <= 844) { db = '+9D6'; build = '10'; }
  else if (total >= 845 && total <= 924) { db = '+10D6'; build = '11'; }
  else if (total >= 925 && total <= 1004) { db = '+11D6'; build = '12'; }
  else if (total >= 1005 && total <= 1084) { db = '+12D6'; build = '13'; }
  else if (total >= 1085 && total <= 1164) { db = '+13D6'; build = '14'; }
  else if (total >= 1165 && total <= 1244) { db = '+14D6'; build = '15'; }
  else { db = '+15D6'; build = '16'; }
  return { hp: hp, san: san, mp: mp, db: db, build: build };
}

function parseOccSkills(occId) {
  STATE.occSkillNames = [];
  STATE.choiceSkillNames = [];
  var occ = OCCUPATIONS.find(function(o) { return o.id === occId; });
  if (!occ) return;
  var skillText = occ.skills || '';
  var parts = skillText.split('，');
  parts.forEach(function(p) {
    var clean = p.replace(/[（(][^)）]*[)）]/g, '').trim();
    if (clean) {
      if (clean.indexOf('或') > -1) {
        var choices = clean.split('或');
        choices.forEach(function(c) {
          var name = c.trim();
          if (name) STATE.choiceSkillNames.push(name);
        });
      } else {
        STATE.occSkillNames.push(clean);
      }
    }
  });
}

function parseOptionalSkills(occId) {
  STATE.optionalSkillNames = [];
  STATE.personalTalentCount = 0;
  var occ = OCCUPATIONS.find(function(o) { return o.id === occId; });
  if (!occ) return;
  var text = occ.skills || '';
  var matches = text.match(/[（(]([^）)]*)[）)]/g);
  if (matches) {
    matches.forEach(function(m) {
      var cleaned = m.replace(/[（(）)]/g, '');
      var items = cleaned.split('、');
      items.forEach(function(item) {
        var name = item.trim();
        if (name && !name.includes('任') && !name.includes('如')) {
          STATE.optionalSkillNames.push(name);
        }
      });
    });
  }
  var talentMatch = text.match(/任意([一二三四五六七八九十\d]+)项/);
  if (talentMatch) {
    var numMap = { '一':1, '二':2, '三':3, '四':4, '五':5, '六':6, '七':7, '八':8, '九':9, '十':10 };
    var num = parseInt(talentMatch[1], 10);
    if (isNaN(num)) num = numMap[talentMatch[1]] || 0;
    STATE.personalTalentCount = num;
  } else {
    var altMatch = text.match(/任意(\d+)项/);
    if (altMatch) {
      STATE.personalTalentCount = parseInt(altMatch[1], 10) || 0;
    }
  }
  if (STATE.personalTalentNames.length > STATE.personalTalentCount) {
    STATE.personalTalentNames = STATE.personalTalentNames.slice(0, STATE.personalTalentCount);
  }
}

// ---- 技能加点核心 ----
function calcSkillPoints() {
  var edu = parseInt(el.fEDU.value, 10) || 10;
  var intel = parseInt(el.fINT.value, 10) || 10;
  var occId = STATE.selectedOccId;
  var occ = OCCUPATIONS.find(function(o) { return o.id === occId; });
  var occPoints = 0;
  if (occ && occ.skillPoints) {
    var formula = occ.skillPoints;
    var matchEdu = formula.match(/教育×(\d+)/);
    if (matchEdu) occPoints += edu * parseInt(matchEdu[1], 10);
    var matchDex = formula.match(/敏捷×(\d+)/);
    if (matchDex) { var dex = parseInt(el.fDEX.value, 10) || 10; occPoints += dex * parseInt(matchDex[1], 10); }
    var matchStr = formula.match(/力量×(\d+)/);
    if (matchStr) { var str = parseInt(el.fSTR.value, 10) || 10; occPoints += str * parseInt(matchStr[1], 10); }
    var matchApp = formula.match(/外貌×(\d+)/);
    if (matchApp) { var app = parseInt(el.fAPP.value, 10) || 10; occPoints += app * parseInt(matchApp[1], 10); }
    var matchWill = formula.match(/意志×(\d+)/);
    if (matchWill) { var will = parseInt(el.fPOW.value, 10) || 10; occPoints += will * parseInt(matchWill[1], 10); }
    var matchSiz = formula.match(/体型×(\d+)/);
    if (matchSiz) { var siz = parseInt(el.fSIZ.value, 10) || 10; occPoints += siz * parseInt(matchSiz[1], 10); }
  }
  var interestPoints = intel * 2;
  return { occPoints: occPoints, interestPoints: interestPoints };
}

function renderSkillList() {

  var filter = el.skillFilter.value;

  var dex = parseInt(el.fDEX.value, 10) || 10;

  var filtered = SKILL_DATA.filter(function(sk) {
    var matchName = sk.name.toLowerCase().includes(search);
    if (filter === 'all') return matchName;
    if (filter === 'combat') return matchName && (sk.category === 'combat');
    if (filter === 'social') return matchName && (sk.category === 'social');
    if (filter === 'knowledge') return matchName && (sk.category === 'knowledge');
    if (filter === 'technical') return matchName && (sk.category === 'technical');
    if (filter === 'occult') return matchName && (sk.category === 'occult');
    if (filter === 'other') return matchName && (sk.category === 'other');
    return matchName;
  });

    html = '<div style="padding:20px;text-align:center;color:var(--nuo-fg-dim);font-size:13px;">没有匹配的技能</div>';
  } else {
    filtered.forEach(function(sk) {
      var skData = STATE.skills.find(function(s) { return s.id === sk.id; }) || { growth: 0, occ: 0, interest: 0 };
      var base = getSkillBase(sk.id, { dex: dex, edu: edu, str: 10, con: 10, siz: 10, app: 10, int: 10, pow: 10, luk: 10 });
      var total = base + skData.growth + skData.occ + skData.interest;

      var isOcc = isOccupationSkill(sk.name) || (sk.id === 'credit');
      var isChoice = isChoiceSkill(sk.name);
      var hasError = STATE.skillErrors.indexOf(sk.id) > -1;

      var isTalent = STATE.personalTalentNames.some(function(t) { return t && (t.toLowerCase().includes(sk.name.toLowerCase()) || sk.name.toLowerCase().includes(t.toLowerCase())); });
      var isWeapon = isWeaponSkill(sk.name);
      var displayName = getSkillDisplayName(sk.id, STATE);
      var isTalentReplaced = STATE.personalTalentNames.some(function(t) { return t && (t.toLowerCase().includes(displayName.toLowerCase()) || displayName.toLowerCase().includes(t.toLowerCase())); });
      var canUseOcc = isOcc || isOptional || isTalent || isWeapon || isTalentReplaced || sk.id === 'credit';

      var rowClass = 'skill-row';
      if (isOcc) rowClass += ' is-occupation';
      if (isChoice) rowClass += ' is-choice';

      html += '<div class="s-input-wrap"><input class="s-input" type="number" min="0" max="99" value="' + skData.growth + '" data-field="growth" data-id="' + sk.id + '"' + (sk.id === 'cthulhu' ? ' style="background:rgba(200,170,80,0.15);"' : '') + '></div>';

      html += '<div class="s-input-wrap"><input class="s-input' + (hasError ? ' error-input' : '') + '" type="number" min="0" max="99" value="' + skData.occ + '" data-field="occ" data-id="' + sk.id + '"' + (occDisabled ? ' disabled' : '') + '></div>';

      html += '<div class="s-input-wrap"><input class="s-input" type="number" min="0" max="99" value="' + skData.interest + '" data-field="interest" data-id="' + sk.id + '"></div>';

      html += '<div class="s-total" id="total-' + sk.id + '">' + total + '</div>';

      html += '</div>';
    });

  el.skillList.querySelectorAll('.s-input').forEach(function(inp) {
    inp.addEventListener('input', function() {
      handleSkillInput(this);
    });

      if (val < 0) this.value = 0;
      if (val > 99) this.value = 99;
      handleSkillInput(this);
    });
  });

  updateSkillStats();
}

function handleSkillInput(inp) {
  var id = inp.getAttribute('data-id');
  var field = inp.getAttribute('data-field');
  var val = parseInt(inp.value, 10) || 0;
  if (val < 0) val = 0;
  if (val > 99) val = 99;
  var sk = STATE.skills.find(function(s) { return s.id === id; });
  if (sk) {
    sk[field] = val;
    STATE.isDirty = true;
    updateSkillStats();
  }
}

function updateSkillStats() {
  var edu = parseInt(el.fEDU.value, 10) || 10;
  var dex = parseInt(el.fDEX.value, 10) || 10;

  var points = calcSkillPoints();
  var totalOcc = points.occPoints;
  var totalInterest = points.interestPoints;

  var usedOcc = 0, usedInterest = 0;
  STATE.skills.forEach(function(s) {
    usedOcc += s.occ || 0;
    usedInterest += s.interest || 0;
  });

  el.spOccupation.textContent = totalOcc;
  el.spOccRemain.textContent = '剩余：' + (totalOcc - usedOcc);
  el.spInterest.textContent = totalInterest;
  el.spIntRemain.textContent = '剩余：' + (totalInterest - usedInterest);
  el.spGrowth.textContent = '∞';
  el.spGrowRemain.textContent = '';

  STATE.skillErrors = [];
  STATE.skills.forEach(function(s) {
    if (s.occ > 0) {
      var sk = SKILL_DATA.find(function(x) { return x.id === s.id; });
      if (sk) {
        var displayName = getSkillDisplayName(sk.id, STATE);
        var isOcc = isOccupationSkill(sk.name) || (sk.id === 'credit');
        var isOptional = isSkillSelectedOptional(sk.name);
        var isTalent = STATE.personalTalentNames.some(function(t) { return t && (t.toLowerCase().includes(sk.name.toLowerCase()) || sk.name.toLowerCase().includes(t.toLowerCase())); });
        var isWeapon = isWeaponSkill(sk.name);
        var isTalentReplaced = STATE.personalTalentNames.some(function(t) { return t && (t.toLowerCase().includes(displayName.toLowerCase()) || displayName.toLowerCase().includes(t.toLowerCase())); });
        var canUseOcc = isOcc || isOptional || isTalent || isWeapon || isTalentReplaced || sk.id === 'credit';
        if (sk.id === 'cthulhu') canUseOcc = false;
        if (!canUseOcc) {
          STATE.skillErrors.push(s.id);
        }
      }
    }
  });

  var errorMsg = '';
  var hasError = false;
  if ((totalOcc - usedOcc) < 0) { hasError = true; errorMsg += '职业点数超出！'; }
  if ((totalInterest - usedInterest) < 0) { hasError = true; errorMsg += '兴趣点数超出！'; }
  if (STATE.skillErrors.length > 0) {
    hasError = true;
    var errorNames = STATE.skillErrors.map(function(id) {
      var sk = SKILL_DATA.find(function(x) { return x.id === id; });
      return sk ? getSkillDisplayName(sk.id, STATE) : id;
    }).join('、');
    errorMsg += '错误分配（' + errorNames + '）';
  }

  if (hasError) {
    el.skillError.style.display = 'flex';
    el.skillErrorMsg.textContent = errorMsg;
    el.skillErrorClearBtn.style.display = STATE.skillErrors.length > 0 ? 'inline-block' : 'none';
  } else {
    el.skillError.style.display = 'none';
    el.skillErrorClearBtn.style.display = 'none';
  }

  STATE.skills.forEach(function(s) {
    var sk = SKILL_DATA.find(function(x) { return x.id === s.id; });
    if (!sk) return;
    var base = getSkillBase(sk.id, { dex: dex, edu: edu, str: 10, con: 10, siz: 10, app: 10, int: 10, pow: 10, luk: 10 });
    var total = base + s.growth + s.occ + s.interest;
    if (total > 99) total = 99;
    var totalEl = document.getElementById('total-' + sk.id);
    if (totalEl) totalEl.textContent = total;
    var occInput = document.querySelector('.skill-row[data-id="' + sk.id + '"] .s-input[data-field="occ"]');
    if (occInput) {
      var displayName = getSkillDisplayName(sk.id, STATE);
      var isOcc = isOccupationSkill(sk.name) || (sk.id === 'credit');
      var isOptional = isSkillSelectedOptional(sk.name);
      var isTalent = STATE.personalTalentNames.some(function(t) { return t && (t.toLowerCase().includes(sk.name.toLowerCase()) || sk.name.toLowerCase().includes(t.toLowerCase())); });
      var isWeapon = isWeaponSkill(sk.name);
      var isTalentReplaced = STATE.personalTalentNames.some(function(t) { return t && (t.toLowerCase().includes(displayName.toLowerCase()) || displayName.toLowerCase().includes(t.toLowerCase())); });
      var canUseOcc = isOcc || isOptional || isTalent || isWeapon || isTalentReplaced || sk.id === 'credit';
      if (sk.id === 'cthulhu') canUseOcc = false;
      var hasError = STATE.skillErrors.indexOf(sk.id) > -1;
      if (hasError) occInput.classList.add('error-input');
      else occInput.classList.remove('error-input');
      occInput.disabled = !canUseOcc;
    }
  });
}

function doSaveChar(overwrite) {
  if (STATE.skillErrors.length > 0) {
    el.errMsg.textContent = '❌ 存在错误分配，请修正后再保存';
    showFormStep(4);
    return;
  }
  var points = calcSkillPoints();
  var usedOcc = 0, usedInterest = 0;
  STATE.skills.forEach(function(s) {
    usedOcc += s.occ || 0;
    usedInterest += s.interest || 0;
  });
  if (usedOcc > points.occPoints) {
    el.errMsg.textContent = '❌ 职业点数超出上限，请调整';
    showFormStep(4);
    return;
  }
  if (usedInterest > points.interestPoints) {
    el.errMsg.textContent = '❌ 兴趣点数超出上限，请调整';
    showFormStep(4);
    return;
  }

  var data = collectFormData();
  if (!data.name) { el.errMsg.textContent = '请填写角色姓名'; return; }
  if (!data.gender) { el.errMsg.textContent = '请选择性别'; return; }
  if (!data.age || data.age < 1 || data.age > 120) { el.errMsg.textContent = '请填写有效年龄（1~120）'; return; }

  var char, saveFn;
  if (STATE.isEditMode && STATE.editingId) {
    saveFn = function() {
      return getCharById(STATE.editingId).then(function(existing) {
        if (existing) {
          if (overwrite) {
            char = existing; Object.assign(char, data); char.updatedAt = Date.now(); char.isComplete = true; return saveChar(char);
          } else {
            char = getDefaultChar(); Object.assign(char, data); char.name = data.name + ' (副本)'; char.isComplete = true; return saveChar(char);
          }
        } else {
          char = getDefaultChar(); Object.assign(char, data); char.isComplete = true; return saveChar(char);
        }
      });
    };
  } else {
    saveFn = function() { char = getDefaultChar(); Object.assign(char, data); char.isComplete = true; return saveChar(char); };
  }
  saveFn().then(function() {
    el.errMsg.textContent = '✅ 已保存：' + char.name;
    setTimeout(function() { if (el.errMsg.textContent === '✅ 已保存：' + char.name) el.errMsg.textContent = ''; }, 2000);
    STATE.isDirty = false;
    refreshCharList();
    showPage('list');
  }).catch(function(e) { el.errMsg.textContent = '保存失败：' + e.message; });
}

function generateMadness(type) {
  getCurrentCharId().then(function(id) {
    if (!id) { el.errMsg.textContent = '没有当前角色'; return; }
    getCharById(id).then(function(char) {
      if (!char) return;
      
      var list = type === 'immediate' ? MADNESS_IMMEDIATE : MADNESS_SUMMARY;
      var idx = rollDice(list.length) - 1;
      var item = list[idx];
      
      var madnessEntry = { type: type, name: item.name, desc: item.desc };
      
      if (!char.madness) char.madness = [];
      char.madness.push(madnessEntry);
      
      saveChar(char).then(function() {
        loadCurrentChar();
        el.errMsg.textContent = '✅ 已添加：' + item.name;
        setTimeout(function() { if (el.errMsg.textContent === '✅ 已添加：' + item.name) el.errMsg.textContent = ''; }, 2000);
        if (item.name.indexOf('恐惧') > -1 && type === 'immediate') {
          setTimeout(function() { showSubRoller('phobia', char.madness.length - 1); }, 300);
        } else if (item.name.indexOf('狂躁') > -1 && type === 'immediate') {
          setTimeout(function() { showSubRoller('mania', char.madness.length - 1); }, 300);
        }
      });
    });
  });
}

function showSubRoller(subType, idx) {
  var items = document.querySelectorAll('.madness-item');
  if (idx >= items.length) return;
  var itemEl = items[idx];
  if (itemEl.querySelector('.madness-sub-area')) return;
  
  var list = subType === 'phobia' ? PHOBIA_LIST : MANIA_LIST;
  var label = subType === 'phobia' ? '🎲 恐惧详情' : '🎲 狂躁详情';
  
  var subArea = document.createElement('div');
  subArea.className = 'madness-sub-area';
  subArea.innerHTML = '<span class="sub-label">' + label + '</span>' +
    '<button class="madness-sub-btn" data-subtype="' + subType + '" data-idx="' + idx + '">🎲 随机抽取</button>' +
    '<div class="sub-result" style="font-size:11px;color:var(--nuo-fg-dim);margin-top:2px;"></div>';
  
  itemEl.appendChild(subArea);
  
  subArea.querySelector('.madness-sub-btn').addEventListener('click', function() {
    var sType = this.getAttribute('data-subtype');
    var iIdx = parseInt(this.getAttribute('data-idx'), 10);
    var listData = sType === 'phobia' ? PHOBIA_LIST : MANIA_LIST;
    var rIdx = rollDice(listData.length) - 1;
    var result = listData[rIdx];
    
    var resultDiv = this.parentElement.querySelector('.sub-result');
    if (resultDiv) {
      resultDiv.textContent = '📌 ' + result;
      resultDiv.style.color = 'var(--nuo-accent)';
      resultDiv.style.fontWeight = '600';
    }
    
    getCurrentCharId().then(function(id) {
      if (!id) return;
      getCharById(id).then(function(char) {
        if (!char || !char.madness || iIdx >= char.madness.length) return;
        char.madness[iIdx].desc = result;
        saveChar(char);
      });
    });
  });
}

function removeMadness(idx) {
  getCurrentCharId().then(function(id) {
    if (!id) return;
    getCharById(id).then(function(char) {
      if (!char || !char.madness || idx >= char.madness.length) return;

function getAllModules() {
  return nuo.storage.get('cocModules').then(function(data) {

}

function saveModules(modules) {
  return nuo.storage.set('cocModules', modules);
}

function getModuleById(id) {
  return getAllModules().then(function(modules) {
    return modules.find(function(m) { return m.id === id; }) || null;
  });
}

function deleteModule(id) {
  return getAllModules().then(function(modules) {
    var newList = modules.filter(function(m) { return m.id !== id; });
    return saveModules(newList);
  });
}

function getCurrentModuleId() {
  return nuo.storage.get('cocCurrentModuleId').then(function(id) {

}

function setCurrentModuleId(id) {

}

function genModuleId() {
  return 'mod_' + Date.now().toString(36) + Math.random().toString(36).substr(2, 4);

function saveModuleData(mod) {
  return getAllModules().then(function(modules) {
    var idx = modules.findIndex(function(m) { return m.id === mod.id; });
    if (idx !== -1) {
      modules[idx] = mod;
      return saveModules(modules);
    }
    return Promise.resolve();
  });
}

function renderPages(contentEl, pages, currentPage) {
  contentEl.innerHTML = '';
  pages.forEach(function(p, idx) {
    var div = document.createElement('div');
    div.className = 'm-page' + (idx === currentPage ? ' active' : '');
    div.textContent = p;
    var numDiv = document.createElement('div');
    numDiv.className = 'm-page-number';
    numDiv.textContent = '— ' + (idx + 1) + ' / ' + pages.length + ' —';
    div.appendChild(numDiv);
    contentEl.appendChild(div);
  });
}

function updatePageView(contentEl) {
  var pages = contentEl._pages;
  var current = contentEl._currentPage;
  var pageEls = contentEl.querySelectorAll('.m-page');
  pageEls.forEach(function(el, idx) {
    el.classList.toggle('active', idx === current);
  });
  document.getElementById('mViewPageInfo').textContent = (current + 1) + ' / ' + pages.length;
  document.getElementById('mViewPrev').disabled = (current <= 0);
  document.getElementById('mViewNext').disabled = (current >= pages.length - 1);
  
  var modId = contentEl._moduleId;
  if (modId) {
    getModuleById(modId).then(function(mod) {
      if (mod) {
        mod.currentPage = current;
        saveModuleData(mod);
        renderBookmarks(mod);
        renderNotes(mod);
      }
    });
  }
}

function renderBookmarks(mod) {
  var container = document.getElementById('mBookmarkList');
  var area = document.getElementById('mViewBookmarks');
  var bookmarks = mod.bookmarks || [];
  
  if (bookmarks.length === 0) {
    area.style.display = 'none';
    return;
  }
  area.style.display = 'block';
  
  var currentPage = mod.currentPage || 0;
  var html = '';
  bookmarks.forEach(function(bm, idx) {
    var isCurrent = (bm.page === currentPage);
    html += '<span class="bookmark-tag' + (isCurrent ? ' current' : '') + '" data-idx="' + idx + '">' +
      '📍 ' + (bm.label || ('第' + (bm.page + 1) + '页')) +
      '<span class="bm-remove" data-idx="' + idx + '">✕</span>' +
      '</span>';
  });
  container.innerHTML = html;
  
  container.querySelectorAll('.bookmark-tag').forEach(function(tag) {
    tag.addEventListener('click', function(e) {
      if (e.target.classList.contains('bm-remove')) return;
      var idx = parseInt(this.getAttribute('data-idx'), 10);
      var bm = bookmarks[idx];
      if (bm && bm.page !== undefined) {
        var contentEl = document.getElementById('mViewContent');
        if (contentEl._pages && bm.page < contentEl._pages.length) {
          contentEl._currentPage = bm.page;
          updatePageView(contentEl);
        }
      }
    });
  });
  
  container.querySelectorAll('.bm-remove').forEach(function(btn) {
    btn.addEventListener('click', function(e) {
      e.stopPropagation();
      var idx = parseInt(this.getAttribute('data-idx'), 10);
      bookmarks.splice(idx, 1);
      mod.bookmarks = bookmarks;
      saveModuleData(mod).then(function() {
        renderBookmarks(mod);
      });
    });
  });
}

function renderNotes(mod) {
  var container = document.getElementById('mNoteList');
  var currentPage = mod.currentPage || 0;
  var notes = (mod.notes || []).filter(function(n) { return n.page === currentPage; });
  
  if (notes.length === 0) {
    container.innerHTML = '<div class="note-empty">暂无笔记，点击「新增笔记」记录</div>';
    return;
  }
  
  var html = '';
  notes.forEach(function(n, idx) {
    var timeStr = n.time ? new Date(n.time).toLocaleString('zh-CN') : '';
    html += '<div class="note-item" data-idx="' + idx + '">' +
      '<span class="note-content">' + n.text + '</span>' +
      '<span class="note-meta">' + timeStr + '</span>' +
      '<span class="note-del" data-idx="' + idx + '">✕</span>' +
      '</div>';
  });
  container.innerHTML = html;
  
  container.querySelectorAll('.note-del').forEach(function(btn) {
    btn.addEventListener('click', function() {
      var idx = parseInt(this.getAttribute('data-idx'), 10);
      var notesList = (mod.notes || []).filter(function(n) { return n.page === currentPage; });
      if (idx < notesList.length) {
        var targetNote = notesList[idx];
        var allNotes = mod.notes || [];
        var realIdx = allNotes.indexOf(targetNote);
        if (realIdx !== -1) {
          allNotes.splice(realIdx, 1);
          mod.notes = allNotes;
          saveModuleData(mod).then(function() {
            renderNotes(mod);
          });
        }
      }
    });
  });
}

    contentEl._currentPage = 0;

      contentEl._currentPage = savedPage;
      renderPages(contentEl, mod.pages, savedPage);
      document.getElementById('mViewNav').style.display = 'flex';
      document.getElementById('mViewPageInfo').textContent = (savedPage + 1) + ' / ' + mod.pages.length;

      document.getElementById('mViewPaginateBtn').style.display = 'inline-block';

      contentEl.appendChild(div);
      document.getElementById('mViewPaginateBtn').style.display = 'inline-block';

  });

// ---- 分页按钮（每页 400 字，方便复制） ----
document.getElementById('mViewPaginateBtn').addEventListener('click', function() {
  var contentEl = document.getElementById('mViewContent');
  var modId = contentEl._moduleId;
  if (!modId) return;
  
  getModuleById(modId).then(function(mod) {
    if (!mod || !mod.content) return;
    var text = mod.content;
    
    var paragraphs = text.split(/\n\s*\n/).filter(function(p) { return p.trim(); });
    if (paragraphs.length === 0) paragraphs = [text];
    
    var pages = [];
    var currentPage = '';
    var currentLen = 0;
    var targetSize = 400; // 从 800 改为 400，每页字数更少，方便复制
    
    paragraphs.forEach(function(p) {
      var pLen = p.length;
      if (currentLen === 0) {
        currentPage = p;
        currentLen = pLen;
      } else if (currentLen + pLen + 2 <= targetSize * 1.3) {
        currentPage += '\n\n' + p;
        currentLen += pLen + 2;
      } else {
        pages.push(currentPage);
        currentPage = p;
        currentLen = pLen;
      }
    });
    if (currentPage) pages.push(currentPage);
    
    if (pages.length <= 1) {
      contentEl.innerHTML = '';
      var div = document.createElement('div');
      div.className = 'm-page active';
      div.textContent = text;
      contentEl.appendChild(div);
      document.getElementById('mViewNav').style.display = 'none';
      document.getElementById('mViewInfo').textContent = '共 ' + text.length + ' 字（1页）';
      mod.paginated = false;
      mod.pages = null;
      mod.currentPage = 0;
      saveModuleData(mod);
      return;
    }
    
    mod.paginated = true;
    mod.pages = pages;
    mod.currentPage = 0;
    saveModuleData(mod).then(function() {
      contentEl._pages = pages;
      contentEl._currentPage = 0;
      renderPages(contentEl, pages, 0);
      document.getElementById('mViewNav').style.display = 'flex';
      document.getElementById('mViewPageInfo').textContent = '1 / ' + pages.length;
      document.getElementById('mViewPrev').disabled = true;
      document.getElementById('mViewNext').disabled = false;
      document.getElementById('mViewInfo').textContent = '共 ' + text.length + ' 字，' + pages.length + ' 页';
      renderBookmarks(mod);
    });
  });
});

    showConfirm('🗑 删除模组', '确定要删除「' + name + '」吗？此操作不可撤销。',
      function() {
        deleteModule(modId).then(function() {
          getCurrentModuleId().then(function(curId) {
            if (curId === modId) setCurrentModuleId(null);
          });
          el.errMsg.textContent = '已删除：' + name;
          setTimeout(function() { if (el.errMsg.textContent === '已删除：' + name) el.errMsg.textContent = ''; }, 1500);
          refreshModuleList();
          showModulePage('moduleList');
        });
      },
      null, '确定删除', '取消');
  });
});

document.getElementById('mSaveBtn').addEventListener('click', function() {
  var name = document.getElementById('mName').value.trim();
  var brief = document.getElementById('mBrief').value.trim();
  var content = document.getElementById('mContent').value.trim();
  
  if (!name) { el.errMsg.textContent = '请填写模组名称'; return; }
  if (!content) { el.errMsg.textContent = '请填写模组正文内容'; return; }
  
  var newModule = {
    id: genModuleId(),
    name: name,
    brief: brief,
    content: content,
    paginated: false,
    pages: null,
    currentPage: 0,
    bookmarks: [],
    isPinned: false,
    notes: [],
    createdAt: Date.now(),
    updatedAt: Date.now()
  };
  
  getAllModules().then(function(modules) {
    modules.push(newModule);
    return saveModules(modules);
  }).then(function() {
    el.errMsg.textContent = '✅ 已保存模组：' + name;
    setTimeout(function() { if (el.errMsg.textContent === '✅ 已保存模组：' + name) el.errMsg.textContent = ''; }, 2000);
    setCurrentModuleId(newModule.id);
    refreshModuleRecent();
    showModulePage('moduleHome');
  }).catch(function(e) {
    el.errMsg.textContent = '保存失败：' + e.message;
  });
});

document.getElementById('mCancelBtn').addEventListener('click', function() {
  showModulePage('moduleHome');
});

function showHomePage() {
  el.pageHome.style.display = 'flex';
  el.errMsg.textContent = '';
  el.confirmOverlay.style.display = 'none';
  el.exitConfirmOverlay.style.display = 'none';
  el.currentEmpty.style.display = 'block';
  refreshCharList();
  setTimeout(function() { updateDerivedStats(); }, 100);
  nuo.ready();
}

function init() {
  // 先检查固定模组
  getCurrentModuleId().then(function(curId) {
    if (curId) {
      getModuleById(curId).then(function(mod) {
        if (mod && mod.isPinned) {
          // 隐藏所有页面
          document.querySelectorAll('.page').forEach(function(p) { p.style.display = 'none'; });
          // 显示模组页面容器
          var modulePage = document.getElementById('pageModule');
          if (modulePage) modulePage.style.display = 'flex';
          // 延迟一下让 DOM 渲染，然后直接查看模组（不显示主页）
          setTimeout(function() {
            viewModule(curId);
            // viewModule 内部会调用 showModulePage('moduleView')，会处理好子页面切换
          }, 50);
          return;
        }
        // 没有固定模组，正常显示主页
        showHomePage();
      });
    } else {
      showHomePage();
    }
  }).catch(function() {
    showHomePage();
  });
}

init().catch(function(e) { nuo.log('Init error: ' + String(e)); nuo.ready(); });
